clue.text: Tempo has changed penning Queen air

indicators.note: something that has changed is no longer in its original form, so the letters take a new order

blocks.note: eight letters to rearrange

explanation.walkthrough: 'has' belongs to the anagram fodder rather than being a link: rearrange TEMPO HAS into ATMOSPHE, then pen ER inside it to make ATMOSPHERE.
explanation.definitionFit: The atmosphere is the gaseous layer surrounding Earth, so it is simply another word for the air we breathe.
